display_name: Awareness E10: Downloads and fake checks (defend only)
description: An awareness episode of about 8 minutes for all staff, on the defending side only. A morning of web pages at Quayholt Insurance, a fictional company: fake checks, fake updates, fake alarms, extension prompts and dangerous downloads, with the genuine ones mixed in. Each answer is explained, and reporting when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down.
